entities.summary: Elizabeth Gitaū also Elizabeth Gitaū-Maina, is a Kenyan physician and corporate executive, who is the chief executive officer of Kenya Medical Association, the national industry association that aims at championing and preserving the interests of the medical doctors practicing in the country.
